name: unzip
summary: Extracts the files from a .zip archive.
description: Extracts the contents of a .zip archive into the current directory, or elsewhere with -d. If a file already exists, unzip asks what to do. Tip: list the contents first with -l, because some archives have no top-level folder and scatter their files around.

options.description: Directory to extract into (created if it does not exist).
Lists the contents of the archive without extracting it.
Checks the integrity of the archive.

example.output:
testing: project/README.md   OK
No errors detected in compressed data of archive.zip.

options.description: Extracts every file at the same level, without recreating directories.
Excludes the files matching the patterns that follow.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Specific files to extract. Default: everything.

examples.explanation: Extracts the archive into the current directory.

dangerNote: With -o, existing files are overwritten without confirmation. When in doubt, list the contents with -l before extracting.
